description: This PHP source file defines the EmailDao class, which interacts with email and email template entities in a Human Resource Management system. It provides methods to retrieve emails by name and to fetch email template matches based on various criteria such as role and locale.

classes.name: EmailDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling email and email template entities, providing methods to retrieve specific emails and matching email templates based on parameters.

methods.name: getEmailByName
methods.description: Retrieves an Email entity by its name.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateMatches
methods.description: Fetches email templates that match given criteria such as email name, locale, recipient role, and performer role.
